model.en: Alert when the upper estimate (p90) of tomorrow's maximum is 35 C or more.

block.en: Alert when the block forecast of tomorrow's maximum is 35 C or more.

notes: Synthetic demo data: every number comes from the mock data generator, not real weather. This is proxy validation on synthetic truth, not evidence of real-world skill.
Evaluation window TEST 2024-07-17..2024-12-31, 164 issue dates, lead days 1-5, model s5-lgbm-9b632a7b1b. TEST first opened 2026-09-27T15:14:23 for this model version.
Decisions for the next day (lead day 1) in every Panchayat, one per issue date.
correct = acted and the event came, or did not act and it stayed away; wasted_wait = acted (held spraying, alerted, waited) but the event did not come; washed_off = did not act and the event came.
block_baseline uses the raw block forecast B0; block_corrected uses the corrected block forecast B1.
Counts and rates only. No money values until an expert supplies costs.
Thresholds are placeholders awaiting expert review.
